titleEn: Automatic campaign pauses and their causes

en: Why did my campaign pause by itself?

steps: Reasons: wallet_empty (top up), template_unavailable (replace), plan_blocked (renew), internal_error (our team), manual, number quality
edgeCases: Number quality drops to YELLOW/RED or WhatsApp restricts the account: campaigns auto-pause, no new templates until recovered; campaigns never restart by themselves
Wallet empty on shared number; own number is billed by Meta
